snippet.title: Clean Up Earth | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Clean Up Earth, a cosy and rewarding first-person cleaning simulator ✨ where players explore beautiful yet polluted real-world inspired environments 🏝️, restore nature and unwind, solo or with friends. 

Coming 2026 to Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Epic Games Store

Wishlist now on Steam 🔗: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3402720/Clean_Up_Earth/
Join us on Discord 🔗: https://discord.gg/GbCH42vd
Follow us on X 🔗 : https://x.com/CUE_game
